title: Multiple Choice (1 point each)
instructions: Select the best answer for each question.

prompts.question: Which line correctly declares a variable that tracks whether the player is holding the torch?
In C#, which line prints a message to the Unity console?
The player can open the vault only if they are still alive and have a key. Which operator combines those two conditions?
What is the difference between = and == in C#?
answers: = assigns a value; == compares two values
= compares two values; == assigns a value
prompts.correct_answer: = assigns a value; == compares two values

prompts.question: The player takes 8 damage from the goblin. Which line correctly reduces the health variable by 8?
